answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in marble, expire in quartz, and ridge lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 155 aliases thus needs 172 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1720 identities would post 4197 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
